state:
S9-Q06 / ARCH-01 finite checked-cohort contract decision. Verified code/probe at compiler commit 530a0b7e: SourceDb is append-only; add(path,text) makes a fresh database-local SourceId, preserving old bytes. SourceDb has no Clone; Catalog private fields are immutable after load, and Catalog derives Clone. CheckedProgram owns public mutable semantic tables, catalog_version only, and no source/catalog provenance. check_program(db,files,catalog) checks ordered explicit files and returns program + diagnostics; CatalogAnalyzer::analyze_owned calls it on all DB files and returns same moved catalog/program/result. emit(program,EmitSources{db,result,catalog,options}) gates only caller-provided result.complete, then public ir::build reparses ALL db entries. ir::build is itself public and skips completeness admission. Artifact/source-map sources inventory all db entries. Actual consumer probe freshly built from pinned private copy: clean coherent CatalogAnalyzer production control emits OLD; foreign DB with equal SourceIds/spans but changed bytes emits NEW under old facts without error; swapped foreign IDs attach wrong defaults; same-version changed catalog effects changes pure lower to awaited state-read without error; append under same path keeps OLD identity and executable semantics while artifact inventory includes both revisions. Reversed check-file order allocates modules in caller order. Checking one file from two-file DB emits only selected semantics but inventories both. Incomplete production returns E6005 and empty modules; test_only permits incomplete coherent fixtures AND currently permits mismatched swapped cohort. No generated JS runtime, broad suite, or benchmark claim.
Required outcome: release a simple reliable public source/catalog ownership contract before publishing/reusing checked binding facts, caching, or snapshots. Enforce at emit AND public ir::build before parsing/lowering; test_only must bypass only incomplete-analysis, never coherence. Preserve coherent CLI, direct check_program callers, immutable appends and selected file order. Checked files are semantic closure; extra DB entries stay metadata inventory for compatibility, not extra checked semantics. Catalog None vs Some is part of provenance. Keep current supplied result.complete and error-shipping caller responsibilities; no claim that editable semantic tables/diagnostics become authenticated or semantically true. Reports/lint/IDE are mapped consumers with current preconditions, not a new unrelated support migration. No global registry, hash-only proof, or speculative cache. Existing public function signatures should stay where possible; adding private provenance to CheckedProgram prevents external struct literals; repository has only two archived synthetic literals, executable production/tests construct via check_program. Inputs may move; Catalog clones and DB appends must remain valid. Decide whether equivalent separately reconstructed DB/catalog copies are supported, and state the compatibility limit. All alternatives below are proposals, not current APIs; compare the same required outcomes and recommend least complex reliable contract. Advice is not proof or authority.

contract.instructions: Recommend one ownership model for checked-source/catalog lowering before any checked-binding reuse, using all the verified controls as equal acceptance requirements. Explain the most material compatibility tradeoff and uncertainty.

criteria.borrowed_owner: Bind the checked program by Rust lifetimes to original db/catalog references and lower only via those references. Association is enforced structurally. Public owning analyzer/caller signatures must change, append control cannot mutate the DB while the borrow is retained without further redesign, and fresh content-equal owners cannot substitute.
criteria.exact_input_record: Store the exact checked source closure (ID/order/path/text) and cloned complete parsed catalog as private retained inputs, then compare both at lower entrances. Equal independent owners are allowed, changed bytes/effects/order are rejected, and appends remain valid. Burdens: copied text/catalog, full Catalog equality derives and private checked field; existing functions can keep their signatures, old external literals cannot.
criteria.owner_tokens: Associate each source DB and loaded immutable catalog with a private Arc identity allocation, copied by handle into CheckedProgram together with checked source order. Lowering checks allocation identity; DB add and catalog clone preserve it. This is an instance-ownership contract, with no registry/hash or repeated semantics storage. Equivalent independently loaded catalogs/DBs are rejected and need rechecking; moves, owned CLI, direct original-owner calls remain supported. Private provenance prevents old literals but function signatures remain.
